description:
Advances: ancora.review

Severity: High (calibrated). BLOCKS THE EPIC PR.

Concrete failure: mix spec.check --base ecc5e24 exits non-zero with spec.check result=fail tier=branch errors=0 warnings=1. CI smoke runs mix spec.check --base origin/BASE_REF with no continue-on-error, which for a PR into main is that identical command, so the PR is red on 100 percent of runs.

Cause, not a tool bug: .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md changed by exactly one line across all 37 branch commits, status draft to status active. That is spec-meta, which ancora.derive.acknowledgment_is_substantive correctly refuses to count as acknowledgment, while about 1000 lines of review code landed under that untouched contract.

Fix lands ON this branch before the PR. Tracked as a work order because the orchestrator does not author spec contracts; this needs an implementer plus a cold verifier per the epic discipline.

Found by /ship-it preflight, critical review 2026-09-03, finding F1. Verified by execution twice.
title: Acknowledge the shipped ancora.review surface so the gate passes against main
